title: Completed tensor square for the normalized scalar transition
statement: Given a normalized PodReindexCoefficientTransition satisfying its pure-tensor, reduction, and limit clauses, the scalar/reindexing paths commute with the specified completed tensor comparison on every constructible pair.

proof.text: Use the three representative normalization lemmas. The mixed one pastes source scalar normalization with the target-field tensor Model law, moving scalar factors by tensor naturality.
Use the representative coefficient square and the representative chain square. The latter follows from the pre-localization chain calculation and exact-derived coherence.

Restriction to pairs of good constructible representatives is faithful: the restricted localization is essentially surjective, using isomorphism invariance of constructibility. Apply functorSquareTowerDescent, cancel the explicit associator components, and evaluate at (M,N).

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5, expanded scalar compatibility proof

theorem podReindexingTensorCoefficientTransition_tensor
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (D' : PodCompletionReindex l L g) (hD' : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l L g D')
    (T' : PodCompletedTensorReindex l L g D')
    (hT' : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l L g D' T')
    (S : PodReindexCoefficientTransition l E L ι g D D')
    (_hcore : PodReindexCoefficientTransition.Core l E g L ι D D' S) :
    ∀ M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X).map (T.tensor M N).hom ≫
        (scalarTensorOrdinary l E L ι X).hom.app
          ((podOrdinaryReindex l E g).obj M.obj, (podOrdinaryReindex l E g).obj N.obj) ≫
        (integralCompletedTensor l L X).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((S.derived l E L ι g D D').hom.app M.obj)
            ((S.derived l E L ι g D D').hom.app N.obj)) =
      (S.derived l E L ι g D D').hom.app
          ((integralCompletedTensor l E Y).obj (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
        (podOrdinaryReindex l L g).map
          ((scalarTensorOrdinary l E L ι Y).hom.app (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
        (T'.tensor ⟨_, S.sourceConstructible M⟩ ⟨_, S.sourceConstructible N⟩).hom
